# Dr. Samuel Mbote

> Physician (MBChB, Kampala International University; MCS, COSECSA general surgery) and AI/software engineer. IBM-certified AI engineer and full-stack software developer. Works on bioinformatics and NGS pipelines, clinical genomics, LLM and AI-agent evaluation, and trustworthy healthcare AI for low-resource settings. Founder, Daktari Genomed Labs. Open to remote roles and contracts in bioinformatics, AI evaluation, data science and annotation, biomedical research and scientific writing.

## Projects (all MIT-licensed, on GitHub)

- [NGS Variant Pipeline](https://github.com/mbote-droid/ngs-variant-pipeline): Nextflow pipeline from raw reads to an evidence-cited clinical variant report. Germline, somatic (Mutect2), cohort joint genotyping and long-read (minimap2, Clair3, Sniffles2); GIAB accuracy benchmarking; HL7 FHIR output; 164 tests.
- [Precision Onco Africa](https://github.com/mbote-droid/precision-onco-africa): offline-capable multi-agent LLM platform for TP53 variant interpretation. 26 specialist agents including a 6-agent tumour board, an AI reasoning-audit layer (hallucination, citation quality), ClinVar/IARC benchmark (7/7 known pathogenic hotspots correct), runs on 8 GB RAM; 566 tests.
- [NeuroSonix](https://github.com/mbote-droid/Neurosonix): audio annotation and multi-agent evaluation of voice-agent conversations across five quality dimensions; FastAPI + React; 133 tests.
- [Healthcare AI Radar](https://github.com/mbote-droid/healthcare-ai-radar): healthcare-AI literature intelligence with a transparent 0-100 Scoop Score and a five-layer anti-hallucination guardrail; 90 tests.
- [TP53 Bioinformatics Pipeline](https://github.com/mbote-droid/tp53_analysis): sequence retrieval, ORF discovery, phylogenetics, InterPro domain annotation and a cancer-mutation heatmap; 63 tests.

## Skills

Python, TypeScript, SQL, Bash; Nextflow, Snakemake, BioPython, variant calling, GIAB benchmarking; LLM applications, RAG, multi-agent systems, AI evaluation, Keras; FastAPI, Django, Node.js, React, Next.js; Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Google Cloud, IBM Cloud; MATLAB/Octave; data annotation (audio, medical image, clinical text); study design, biostatistics, evidence synthesis, scientific writing.
